title: First time posting. Some recurring imagery and themes of my dreams…
content: Mine is very much a world, full of different locations. My subconscious seems to identify each distinct area as somewhere I know IRL, regardless of the surreal differences. To navigate the world itself, there’s super tall water flume things that reach into the upper atmosphere / low orbit. Travelling enormous distance is a case of hopping down a water tunnel so tall, looking down into it curves in all directions. I often find myself driving a small vehicle, like an old fashioned racing car. It’s small enough for me to stash in a locker or even fold up and carry. Some towns I know are high on hills, and are kinda walled-off like an ancient civilisation. I’m regularly stuck in huge concrete towers that sway in the breeze. Everything is oversized like they’re car parks and not for people. Sometimes I’m trapped on the lip surrounding an elevator shaft. Swimming pools are incredibly ornate buildings, and you just walk down extravagant steps, and the floor becomes water. Collapsed highways and overpasses everywhere.
